title: Audit filter domain neutrality
description: Find where the Filter Controller is biased toward shop, product, price, budget, or rating examples instead of generic field-based filtering.
objective: Make the plugin usable for arbitrary Elementor listings and custom fields without shop-specific assumptions leaking into defaults or UX.
expected_outputs: List of shop/product/price-biased labels, defaults, placeholder copy, keys, and assumptions
Recommended generic defaults and contextual examples
acceptance_criteria: The audit identifies every hard-coded or default value that implies product/price unless explicitly scoped as sample data.
The audit separates useful examples from product-locked behavior.
The audit recommends a data model vocabulary that works for custom fields, taxonomies, text, numbers, dates, and booleans.
verification: rg findings for price/product/shop/budget/rating are included.
No copy or defaults are changed by this task.

budgets.time_budget: one source text and schema audit
budgets.context_budget: defaults, UI labels, filter resolver, preset schema

risks: A shop-biased default can make a technically generic plugin feel like a WooCommerce clone.
